history.summary: A freehold 2BR (764 sqft) near Boon Keng MRT in D12, asking $1.59M ($2,081 psf), listed under a marketing title that masks the actual project and built_year. The PSF is high for an unspecified older FH 2BR, though it sits below new-launch The Arcady (~$2,650 psf) nearby.
history.rating_rationale: $2,081 psf is a punchy price for a 764 sqft 2BR with no disclosed project name or built_year — hard to verify quality, age or the development's track record. It is cheaper than the adjacent new launch (The Arcady ~$2,650 psf), and 460m to Boon Keng MRT supports rental demand. But missing built_year and no URA series are real data gaps; the title's 'high rental' claim is unverified. Fairly priced at best, not a clear value.
